text:
Alex Rivera: Quick update — the RCA for the 2026-03-20 inference outage is posted: https://redwood.internal/rca/2234567890. Short summary and action items below, please skim and ack if you have ownership.

ops-bot: RCA published by @Alex Rivera • https://redwood.internal/rca/2234567890 

Maya Chen: Thanks. Quick question — root cause was routing policy not matching model tags, right?

Alex Rivera: Correct. Routing expected tag 'redwood/llama-3x-quant' but instances reported 'llama-3x-q2' so our fallback rule didn't match.

Alex Rivera: Highlighted actions in the doc:
- A1: Deploy tag-normalization at build/deploy time (owner: @Maya Chen, ETA: 2026-03-27)
- A2: Add automated canary for routing rule changes (owner: @Sam Patel, ETA: 2026-03-26)
- A3: Short-term cache tuning to reduce OOM churn (owner: @Irene Lopez, ETA: 2026-03-24)

Maya Chen: I'll take A1. Plan is to run a small script that maps legacy tags to canonical tags during the deploy pipeline. Example snippet I'm prototyping:
```
# normalize tags in CI
if [[ "$MODEL_TAG" =~ ^llama-3x-q ]]; then
  MODEL_TAG="redwood/llama-3x-quant"
fi
```
I'll open the PR today.

Sam Patel: I'll own A2. Will post the canary config PR and a short runbook. FYI emergency fallback was re-enabled during the incident at 09:18 UTC and served ~600 requests with no errors. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/incidents/2234567890

Irene Lopez: For A3, ops already bumped KV cache eviction threshold and reduced chunk retention for the nights. We'll monitor memory graphs and revert once the canary proves stable.

Maya Chen: Quick win note from doc: we added an alert for tag drift — please verify it's firing in your envs. @Sam can you confirm Canary alerts are included?

Sam Patel: Confirmed — canary alert set (5% error rate within 5m). PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/6789 (config + runbook in PR description).

Alex Rivera: Thanks. Please ack here if you accept the owner/ETA. We'll do a 30-min async check-in next Tue 10:00am PT (calendar invite going out) to verify progress and close items. If anything blocks earlier, ping me or post in #postmortems-checkins.

Irene Lopez: :thumbsup: ack — Irene (Ops).

Maya Chen: :white_check_mark: ack, PR incoming.

Sam Patel: :+1: ack, canary PR up and running on staging.

Alex Rivera: Closing thread for updates — thanks everyone. I'll update the RCA doc with links to PRs and a short timeline summary.
